# The 50.00 invoice the wire also covers, settled by its own split.
#
# It is here to be unposted afterwards: unposting leaves its settlement loose
# on the receivable and marked as this tool's own orphan, which is the state
# the writer of a `prepayment:` line skips and a reader was counting.
#
# What this fixture produces: `INV-USD-004` settled, its −50.00 split in its
# lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-004"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-09
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-09
    description: "A smaller job"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 50
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-09
    due: 2026-02-09
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-004"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-28
    amount: 50
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    memo: "Wire"
    txn_guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500011"
    txn_split_guid: "5150aabb5150ccdd5150eeff51500055"
